environment.name: CPK_SECRETS_DATABASE_PATH
allowed_values: absolute path under the retained provider-data mount

runtime_inputs: root provider bootstrap files are supplied by trusted preflight infrastructure
bootstrap files are not product configuration artifacts and never enter the product descriptor
bootstrap files are not recursively resolved through the provider being started
a nested provider may later receive equivalent files from an already admitted parent provider
provider responses, logs, errors, observations, and catalogue metadata never contain bootstrap values
